Jack & Jones Hagen Sling Bag – Stylish, Compact & Functional Crossbody Bag

The Jack & Jones Hagen Sling Bag is designed for everyday convenience, premium style, and modern functionality. Made from 100% PU Leather, this compact sling bag is perfect for men who prefer a sleek and durable accessory for travel, office, college, or daily use. With a two-compartment design with zip opening, it provides ample space for your essentials while maintaining a clean and minimal look. The convenient front zipper pocket makes it easy to access keys, cards, wallets, and other frequently used items.

The thoughtfully designed detachable shoulder strap and cushioned strap belt offer unmatched comfort, allowing you to wear the sling bag for long hours without strain. With a compact structure measuring 23L × 18H × 5W cm and a storage capacity of 2.5 liters, the is an excellent choice for anyone looking for a lightweight yet high-performance accessory. Whether you’re searching for a premium men’s, a durable crossbody, or a stylish PU leather, this model delivers outstanding value and functionality.

The is crafted to simplify your everyday routine. Its compact measurement ensures that it fits comfortably across your chest or shoulder, making it ideal for commuting, travel, and urban lifestyles. The PU leather fabric gives the  a premium texture, ensuring durability, water resistance, and long-lasting appeal. This makes it one of the most preferred options among customers searching for compact and lightweight crossbody.

With its functional layout, this is suitable for carrying mobile phones, power banks, earphones, wallets, sunglasses, and small accessories. The front zipper pocket adds convenience by keeping your essentials organized and easily accessible. The two-compartment zip opening ensures better storage management, ideal for users who want practicality without compromising style.

Design & Comfort

The Hagen Sling Bag stands out due to its ergonomic design. The detachable shoulder strap adds flexibility, allowing you to switch between a crossbody style and a handheld look. The cushioned strap belt enhances comfort, making it suitable for long-day outings or travel. This thoughtful construction makes the bag a perfect pick for buyers looking for travel men’s PU leather, and daily-use shoulder.

Key Features

  • Brand: Jack & Jones
  • Product: Jack & Jones Hagen Sling Bag
  • Material: 100% PU Leather (Premium, durable & water-resistant)
  • Compartments: Two compartments with zip opening for organized storage
  • Pockets: Front zipper pocket for quick access
  • Strap: Detachable shoulder strap for flexible styling
  • Comfort: Cushioned strap belt for all-day comfort
  • Dimensions: 23L × 18H × 5W cm
  • Capacity: 2.5 liters
  • Use: Ideal for travel, work, college, outdoor activities, and daily carry
